title: Whiteout Survival 集結主・乗り手選定データ
scope: SR全英雄および第1〜第8世代SSR。R英雄・専用装備スキルは対象外。
generationRule: SRはgeneration=1かつalwaysAvailable=true。第1世代以降の全フィルターで表示。

slotDefinitions.A': 通常攻撃ダメージ増加

slotPolicy: 11枠に直接対応する効果のみ付与。防御力上昇、シールド、回避、会心、直接追加攻撃、スキル限定与ダメージ等はslots=[]。複合効果は複数枠。

sources.name: WOS Forge Wiki
sources.role: 英雄別遠征スキル本文・倍率・兵種・世代の主照合元

sources.name: WOS Heroes
sources.role: 英雄別遠征スキル本文・倍率・スキル順の副照合元

sources.role: 世代・兵種・レアリティ、およびHector/Norahのスキル順の照合

sources.name: アルテマ Whiteout Survival攻略
sources.role: 日本語英雄名、第7〜8世代の兵種・遠征効果の補助照合

skills.sourceTextEn: Bahiti senses the dangers ahead, reducing damage taken by 4–20% for all troops.

skills.effect: 攻撃時、与ダメージをLv1〜5で10/20/30/40/50%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Bahiti's battlefield instincts grants all troops' attack a 50% chance of increasing damage dealt by 10–50%.

skills.effect: 領主体力消費をLv1〜5で10/12/15/18/20%減少
skills.sourceTextEn: Gina's strict Governor training regimen can be counted upon to reduce Stamina cost by 10–20%.

skills.condition: 野獣・氷原の怪物への行軍時
skills.sourceTextEn: Gina is a fast and aggressive wilderness rider, boosting Hunting March Speed by 20–100%.
Jasser's combination of courage and wisdom enriches the army, increasing damage dealt by 5–25% for all troops.
Jasser's profound knowledge increases the city's Research Speed by 3–15%.
Jessie implements advanced weaponry for our troops, increasing damage dealt by 5–25% for all troops.
With a keen engineering eye, Jessie enhances troops' armor, reducing damage taken by 4–20% for all troops.
Ling Xue's withering assault has disturbed enemies' formation, reducing all enemy Troops' Attack by 4–20%.
Ling Xue's hands-on, disciplined instruction increases Training Speed by 4–20%.
With Lumak Bokan's expert guerrilla tactics, all enemy troops' damage dealt is reduced by 4–20%.

skills.condition: 野獣・氷原の怪物への行軍時
skills.sourceTextEn: Lumak Bokan passes his people's traditional techniques to the soldiers, increasing Hunting March Speed by 20–100%.
Patrick's culinary masterpieces invigorate our troops, increasing Health by 5–25% for all troops.
Patrick's gourmet meals motivate and unleash the potential of our soldiers, increasing Attack by 5–25% for all troops.
Seo-yoon beats the war drum to boost morale, increasing all Troops Attack by 5–25%.
Seo-yoon treats wounded troops with traditional medicine, increasing Healing Speed in the Infirmary by 10–50%.
Sergey guards our troops with his shield, reducing damage taken by 4–20% for all troops.
Sergey's intimidating presence reduces Attack by 4–20% for all enemy troops.
Jeronimo delivers a rousing rally speech ahead of the battle, increasing damage dealt by 5–25% for all troops.
Jeronimo imparts the secrets of swordsmanship, increasing Attack by 5–25% for all troops.
Jeronimo's sword arts empower soldiers to seize battle opportunities, increasing Damage Dealt by 6–30% for all troops for 2 turns every 4 turns.
Molly creates an avalanche that clouds enemy sights, granting a 40% chance of reducing all troops' Damage Taken by 10–50%.

skills.effect: 攻撃時、与ダメージをLv1〜5で10/20/30/40/50%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Molly excels in snowy terrains, granting all troops' attack a 50% chance of increasing damage dealt by 10–50%.
Hell hath no fury like an angry Molly, increasing damage dealt by 5–25% for all troops.
Natalia commands the beasts to cover your troops, granting a 40% chance of reducing all troops' Damage Taken by 10–50%.
Natalia is a natural leader, increasing Attack by 5–25% for all troops.
Natalia's unexplained connection with nature allows her to rally wild beasts, increasing damage dealt by 5–25% for all troops.

skills.effect: 防御力とHPをそれぞれLv1〜5で2/4/6/8/10%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Zinman the master builder understands what is required of a strong defensive line, increasing Troop's Defense by 2–10% and Health by 2–10%.

skills.effect: 基礎資源の建設消費を3〜15%減少し、建設速度を3〜15%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Zinman's skillful control of the construction workflow reduces basic resource consumption (Meat, Wood, Coal, Iron) by 3–15% and increases Building Upgrade speed by 3–15%.
Zinman masterfully manipulates the battlefield, increasing Lethality by 5–25% for all troops.
Alonso attacks like the waves, granting a 40% chance of increasing all troop's Lethality by 10–50%.

skills.effect: 敵の与ダメージをLv1〜5で10/20/30/40/50%低下
skills.condition: 味方の攻撃時に20%の確率、2ターン
skills.sourceTextEn: Alonso's indomitable will grants all troops' attack a 20% chance of reducing damage dealt by 10–50% for all enemy troops for 2 turns.

skills.effect: 攻撃時、与ダメージをLv1〜5で10/20/30/40/50%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Alonso coats weapons with lethal toxins, granting all troops' attack a 50% chance of dealing 10–50% more damage.
Every flame, no matter how small, can ignite a roaring fire. Flint increases his Infantry's Damage Dealt by 20–100%.
Flint's fire not only dispels the cold but also ignites the passion for battle, increasing Attack by 5–25% for all troops.
Flint's flame of anger devours everything, increasing all troops' Lethality by 5–25%.

skills.effect: 攻撃力を3〜15%、防御力を2〜10%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Philly's secret remedy strengthens the soldiers, increasing Attack by 3–15% and Defense by 2–10% for all troops.
Philly uses her secret tonic to enhance the warriors' strength, granting all troops' attack a 25% chance of dealing 120–200% damage.
Philly's special shot improves troops' focus, granting a 40% chance of reducing all troops' Damage Taken by 10–50%.
Greg transforms our troops into a relentless sword of justice, granting a 20% chance of increasing damage dealt by 8–40% for all troops for 3 turns.

skills.effect: 敵の与ダメージをLv1〜5で10/20/30/40/50%低下
skills.condition: 味方の攻撃時に20%の確率で2ターン
skills.sourceTextEn: Greg uses the authority of the law to intimidate enemies, granting all troops' attack a 20% chance of reducing enemy damage dealt by 10–50% for 2 turns.
Greg's faith in law and order uplifts everyone, increasing Health by 5–25% for all troops.
Logan overwhelms his enemies with a fierce presence, reducing all enemy Troops' Attack by 4–20%.
Logan intimidates his opponents with the ferocity of a lion, reducing damage taken by 4–20% for all troops.
Logan inspires everyone with his inherent leadership qualities, increasing Health by 5–25% for all troops.

skills.effect: 対象の被ダメージをLv1〜5で10/20/30/40/50%上昇
skills.condition: 味方の攻撃時に50%の確率
skills.sourceTextEn: Grants all troops' attack a 50% chance of cursing the target, increasing their damage taken by 10–50%.
Mia brings good luck to the Troops, granting a 50% chance of boosting troops' Attack by 10–50%.
Mia foresees potential dangers before battle, granting a 40% chance of reducing damage taken by 10–50% for all troops.

skills.effect: 被ダメージを槍・弓兵は10〜30%、盾兵は10〜70%減少
skills.condition: 盾兵が4回に1回攻撃を止めた際、2ターン

levelValues.label: Lancer and Marksman Damage Taken Down

skills.sourceTextEn: Ahmose revives the lost art of ancient guardians. His Infantry pauses the attack once every four times, reducing damage taken by Lancers and Marksmen by 10–30% and Infantry by 10–70% for 2 turns.
Ahmose amplifies the combat spirit of friendly Infantry with the power of the Fire Crystal, increasing their damage dealt by 20–100%.

skills.effect: 1攻撃あたりの与ダメージを12〜60%上昇し、対象の被ダメージを5〜25%上昇
skills.condition: 被ダメージ上昇は1ターン
skills.sourceTextEn: Ahmose infuses friendly Infantry's weapons with the essence of Fire Crystals, increasing his infantries' damage dealt per attack by 12–60% and the target's damage taken by 5–25% for 1 turn.
Lynn uplifts our troops with an enthusiastic rhythm, granting a 40% chance of increasing damage dealt by 10–50% for all troops.
Lynn demoralizes the enemies with a somber tune, reducing damage dealt by 4–20% for all enemy troops.

skills.effect: 攻撃3回ごとに攻撃力をLv1〜5で1/2/3/4/5%上昇（重複可）
skills.sourceTextEn: Lynn harnesses the power of music to elevate troops morale, increasing her Marksmen's attack by 1%/2%/3%/4%/5% for every 3 attacks. Stackable and lasts until the end of the battle.

skills.effect: 通常攻撃ダメージをLv1〜5で10/15/20/25/30%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Reina targets enemy weak spots, increasing normal attack damage by 10–30% for all troops.

skills.effect: 通常攻撃を回避する確率をLv1〜5で4/8/12/16/20%付与
skills.sourceTextEn: Reina's adept leadership grants all troops a 4–20% chance of dodging normal attacks.
With Reina's clever tactics, her Lancers have a 25% chance of performing an extra attack, dealing 120–200% damage.
Gwen provides unfettered vision of enemy weakpoints during flights, increasing target's Damage Taken by 5–25%.

skills.effect: 5回攻撃ごとに20〜100%の追加ダメージを与え、対象が次に受けるダメージを5〜15%上昇
skills.condition: 5回攻撃ごと。被ダメージ上昇は次の1回
skills.sourceTextEn: Gwen dominates the skies, granting all troops' attack 20–100% extra damage after every five attacks, and causes the target to receive 5–15% extra damage for its next attack received.

skills.effect: 4回に1回、次の攻撃でLv1〜5で10/20/30/40/50%の追加ダメージ
skills.sourceTextEn: Gwen equips her Marksmen with grenades, dealing 10–50% extra damage to all enemies on the next attack of every 4 attacks.
A seasoned warrior with an uncanny knack for reading the battlefield, Hector's presence has a 40% chance of reducing damage taken by 10–50% for all troops.

skills.effect: 盾兵の与ダメージを100〜200%、弓兵を20〜100%上昇。10回の攻撃に有効で、1回ごとに前回の85%へ減衰
skills.sourceTextEn: Hector excels at raiding on fortified positions with well-coordinated Marksmen, increasing Infantry's Damage Dealt by 100–200% and Marksmen's Damage Dealt by 20–100%, it is effective for 10 attacks, with each attack's damage boost being 85% of the previous one.
Hector has mastered the offensive strategy, granting all troops' attack a 25% chance of dealing 120–200% damage.

skills.effect: 被ダメージを3〜15%減少し、与ダメージを3〜15%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Norah is well trained in combined arms tactics, decreasing Damage Taken by 3–15% and boosting Damage Dealt by 3–15% for Infantry and Marksman.

skills.effect: 敵全体にLv1〜5で20/40/60/80/100%の追加ダメージ
skills.sourceTextEn: Norah has an eye for weaknesses, granting her Lancers a 20% chance of dealing 20–100% extra damage to all enemies on attack.

skills.effect: 与ダメージを5〜25%上昇し、被ダメージを5〜25%減少
skills.condition: 味方槍兵が5回攻撃するごとに2ターン
skills.sourceTextEn: Norah motivates our troops, increasing all troops' damage dealt by 5–25%, and reducing their damage taken by 5–25% every 5 attacks made by lancers for 2 turns.

skills.effect: 夢の印を付け、次ターンにLv1〜5で40/80/120/160/200%の槍兵追加ダメージを1回与える
skills.sourceTextEn: Renee always fights in unbelievable ways. Her Lancers can place Dream Marks on their targets every two turns, dealing 40–200% extra Lancer damage once next turn. The Dream Marks last for 1 turn.

skills.effect: 印が付いた対象への与ダメージをLv1〜5で30/60/90/120/150%上昇
skills.condition: 対象に夢の印がある間
skills.sourceTextEn: Renee's Dream Marks highlight enemy vulnerabilities, increasing her Lancers' damage dealt to marked targets by 30–150%.

skills.effect: 印が付いた対象への与ダメージをLv1〜5で15/30/45/60/75%上昇
skills.condition: 対象に夢の印がある間
skills.sourceTextEn: Renee's Dream Marks expose enemy weaknesses, increasing damage dealt to marked targets by 15–75% for all troops.

skills.effect: 追加攻撃を行い、Lv1〜5で20/40/60/80/100%のダメージ
skills.sourceTextEn: Wayne's brilliant battle planning allows all troops to launch an extra attack every 4 turns, dealing 20–100% damage.

skills.effect: 敵槍兵へ8〜40%、敵弓兵へ4〜20%の追加ダメージ
skills.sourceTextEn: Wayne's stratagems can pierce the thickest of defenses. On every other attack, his Marksmen deal 8–40% extra damage to enemy Lancers and 4–20% extra damage to enemy Marksmen.
Wayne ensures no misstep goes unpunished with an eagle's eye for weakness, granting all troops' attacks a 5–25% Crit Rate.

skills.effect: 通常攻撃の被ダメージを5〜25%、スキルの被ダメージを6〜30%減少
skills.sourceTextEn: Wu Ming moves like a shadow, dodging and countering enemies, reducing his Infantry's damage taken from normal attacks by 5–25% and from skills by 6–30%.
Wu Ming spreads his wisdom and techniques, increasing damage dealt by 4–20% for all troops.

skills.effect: スキルダメージをLv1〜5で5/10/15/20/25%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Wu Ming leads everyone to a heightened affinity with their combat techniques, increasing skill damage dealt by 5–25% for all troops.
Bradley's years of combat experience enables him to destroy enemies efficiently, increasing Attack by 5–25% for all troops.

skills.effect: 敵槍兵への与ダメージを6〜30%、敵盾兵への与ダメージを5〜25%上昇
skills.condition: 対象兵種に応じて適用
skills.sourceTextEn: Bradley uses his expertise in suppressive artillery against the enemy vanguard, increasing Damage Dealt to Lancers by 6–30%, and to Infantry by 5–25% for all troops.
Bradley will press every advantage against a beleaguered enemy, increasing Damage Dealt by 6–30% for all troops for 2 turns every 4 turns.

skills.effect: 味方弓兵の被ダメージを4〜20%減少し、味方槍兵の与ダメージを4〜20%上昇
skills.sourceTextEn: Mr. Tin's colossal presence automatically shields friendly ranged units, reducing Damage Taken by 4–20% for Marksmen, and suppresses the enemy, increasing Damage Dealt by 4–20% for Lancers.
Mr. Tin's metallic body functions as a fortified wall on the field, reducing damage taken by 4–20% for Infantry.
Edith's mobile defense system is reliable, increasing Health by 5–25% for all troops.

skills.effect: 2回攻撃ごとに20〜100%の追加ダメージと1ターンの毒を付与。毒状態の敵は与ダメージが4〜20%低下
skills.sourceTextEn: Gordon dips Lancers' weapons in venom. Every 2 attacks, Lancers deal 20–100% extra damage and apply poison to the target for 1 turn. Poisoned enemies deal 4–20% less damage.

skills.effect: 槍兵の与ダメージを30〜150%上昇し、敵全部隊の与ダメージを6〜30%低下
skills.sourceTextEn: Gordon's envenomed weapons terrorizes the field, increasing Lancers' Damage Dealt by 30–150% and reducing Damage Dealt by 6–30% for all enemy troops for 1 turn, every 3 turns.

skills.effect: 敵盾兵の被ダメージを6〜30%上昇し、敵弓兵の与ダメージを6〜30%低下
skills.sourceTextEn: Gordon generates a defensive bio-toxic fog, confusing enemy frontline Infantry, increasing their Damage Taken by 6–30%, while blocking enemy Marksmen's line of sight to reduce their Damage Dealt by 6–30% for 2 turns every 4 turns.
Gatot commands his troops with imperial guard tactics, increasing his Infantry's Defense by 6–30%.

skills.effect: 攻撃時、攻撃力のLv1〜5で6/12/18/24/30%相当のシールドを付与
skills.sourceTextEn: The great kings blesses Gatot's Infantry, granting Infantry a Shield with protection equal to Attack* 6–30% each time they attack, for 1 turn.
Gatot's formidable legion instills fear in enemies, reducing their Attack by 5–25%.
Captain Hendrik commands a gigantic naval shipworm gnaw at the enemies' armor, reducing all enemy troops' Defense by 5–25%.
Hendrik covers all Troops with a layer of hard-shelled barnacles every 4 turns, increasing their Defense by 6–30% for 2 turns.

skills.effect: 敵全体へLv1〜5で8/16/24/32/40%のダメージ
skills.sourceTextEn: Every 3 turns, the ancient abyssal spirit's descendents will work together with Hendrik's Marksmen to launch an attack, dealing 8–40% damage to all enemies.
“Everyone has a share when the legendary ocean treasure is found!” Sonya's promise inspires everyone, increasing Damage by 4–20% for all troops.

skills.effect: 2回攻撃ごとに槍兵の与ダメージを15〜75%上昇し、味方全部隊の攻撃力を5〜25%上昇
skills.condition: 2回攻撃ごと。攻撃力上昇は1ターン
skills.sourceTextEn: Sonya motivates her Troops with bounty, making her Lancers deal 15–75% more damage every 2 attacks and increasing Attack by 5–25% for all troops for 1 turn.

skills.effect: Lv1〜5で50/100/150/200/250%のダメージを与え、対象を1ターン眩暈
skills.sourceTextEn: Sonya's Lancers will seize every chance to launch a surprise raid like underwater currents. Her Lancers deal 50–250% damage every 5 turns and stun the target for 1 turn.
